title: Understanding the Confusion Matrix
text: A confusion matrix is a tool used to evaluate the performance of a classification model. It shows the number of true positive, true negative, false positive, and false negative predictions. Can you think about how these terms relate to the predictions made by your classifier?

title: Linking Classifier Output to Confusion Matrix
text: Think about how the output of your classifier (0 or 1) can be mapped to the entries in a confusion matrix. What does a true positive or a false negative mean in terms of your classifier's predictions?

title: Mapping Predictions to Confusion Matrix
text: If your classifier predicts $$1$$ and the actual label is $$1$$, which part of the confusion matrix does this correspond to?
